description: Generated by npm run actions:sync. Do not edit by hand. Source of truth: src/handlers/*.ts

actions.name: clear
actions.note: Empties an input. Use this rather than `fill` with an empty string - the validator rejects a `fill` step with empty `data`, so this is the only way to express clearing a field.

actions.name: fill
actions.note: Optional `storeAs` saves the filled value as a runtime variable. `data` must be non-empty - the validator enforces this.

actions.name: goto
actions.note: Navigates the page. No locator involved.

actions.name: left_click
actions.note: Explicit left click. `click` is the normal choice.

actions.name: press_key
actions.note: Falls back to `key`, then to `Enter`.

actions.name: save_storage_state
actions.note: Defaults to `.auth/user.json`. Used to capture an authenticated session for reuse via `config.storageState`.

actions.name: scroll_to
actions.note: Scrolls the element into view.

actions.name: select_option
actions.note: `data` must be non-empty - the validator enforces this.

actions.name: store_text
actions.note: Reads the element's text into a runtime variable. `variable` is required and throws at runtime if absent.

actions.name: switch_new_tab
actions.note: Switches the engine to the most recently opened tab.

actions.name: wait
actions.note: Falls back to `timeout`, then to 1000. Prefer an assertion over a fixed wait where possible.

actions.name: wait_for_element
actions.note: Optional `state` (`visible` default, or `hidden` / `attached` / `detached`) and `timeout` in ms (default 10000). Prefer this over `wait` - a fixed sleep is both slower than needed and still too short under load.

actions.name: verify_attribute
actions.note: `attribute` is required and throws at runtime if absent.

actions.name: verify_element_count
actions.note: Falls back to `count`, then to 0.

actions.name: verify_not_contains_text
actions.note: `data` must be non-empty - the validator enforces this.

actions.name: verify_text
actions.note: Exact match. `data` must be non-empty - the validator enforces this.

actions.name: verify_text_contains
actions.note: Partial match. `data` must be non-empty - the validator enforces this.

actions.name: verify_unchecked
actions.note: Negative counterpart of `verify_checked`.

actions.name: verify_url_contains
actions.note: No locator involved. The preferred assertion for redirection.

actions.name: verify_value
actions.note: Asserts the current value of an input. Use this rather than `verify_attribute` with `value`: typing never updates the HTML value attribute, so `verify_attribute` cannot see what a user entered.

actions.name: verify_visible
actions.note: Do not use on generic wrappers or body containers - assert a concrete outcome instead.

actions.name: verify_visual_snapshot
actions.note: Optional `snapshotName` and `maxDiffPixelRatio` (default 0.05). Name defaults to `<page>_<element>.png`.

actions.name: api_delete
actions.note: Optional `headers`. Optional `expected_status` asserts the response status exactly; without it any 2xx or 3xx passes.

actions.name: api_get
actions.note: Optional `headers` and `store_response` ({ key, variable }). Optional `expected_status` asserts the response status exactly; without it any 2xx or 3xx passes.

actions.name: api_patch
actions.note: Optional `headers` and `store_response` ({ key, variable }). Partial update of a resource. Optional `expected_status` asserts the response status exactly; without it any 2xx or 3xx passes.

actions.name: api_post
actions.note: Optional `headers` and `store_response` ({ key, variable }). Optional `expected_status` asserts the response status exactly; without it any 2xx or 3xx passes.

actions.name: api_put
actions.note: Optional `headers` and `store_response` ({ key, variable }). Full replacement of a resource. Optional `expected_status` asserts the response status exactly; without it any 2xx or 3xx passes.

actions.name: mock_route
actions.note: Optional `mockData` (or `data`), `status` (default 200), `contentType` (default application/json). `status` is the mocked response status and asserts nothing.

actions.name: unmock_route
actions.note: Removes a route mock installed by `mock_route`.

actions.name: call_flow
actions.note: Reusable step sequence. Nesting is capped at depth 10. The validator checks the flow file exists.
